title: Build the city together
summary: Open-source contributions now earn XP, Makers square has a richer construction plan, and mobile invitations reopen smoothly.
changes: Approved pull requests merged into C.I.T.I.E.S now award 100 XP to the linked resident, once per contribution.
Rebuilt Makers square with patterned paving, planted wings, benches, lighting, worktables, staged materials, a canopy, and a landmark sculpture.
Made the square follow its irregular parcel and simplify cleanly when viewing the city from farther away.
Fixed the mobile invitation pane so reopening it returns to the expected position instead of jumping.
Refocused the open-source project guide on the core loop, XP, major mechanics, contribution rewards, and a real city view.

commits: Add contribution XP and enrich Makers square
Prevent mobile invitation pane jumping on reopen
Improve mobile navigation and add reviewed changelogs
